title: finding(core): the `EXPANDABLE_FIELD_TYPES` docblock recommends pinning consumers with a spy on `has`, which is VACUOUS for any consumer that reads the family at two sites in one render — measured, and it let a member-identical private copy pass
body:
## The finding

`packages/core/src/utils/expand-fields.ts` states, in the docblock that governs how consumers of `EXPANDABLE_FIELD_TYPES` are pinned:

> Neither consumer copies the set — both call `.has()` on THIS object, and both carry an **identity pin (a spy on this `has`)** so a member-identical private copy fails rather than quietly re-forking the table.

⭐ **That guarantee does not hold for a consumer with more than one call site, and the docblock does not say so.** A spy on `has` records *that* the shared set was consulted, ⛔ never *which site* consulted it. So in a component where two sites read the family **on the same render**, a call from either one satisfies a recorder installed for the other — and a member-identical private copy at one site passes the pin.

## How it was measured, ⛔ not reasoned

Found on objectui#10112 by **running** an ablation rather than reading the pin. `RelatedList` consults the family at two sites on one render — the `$expand` roots and the batch label fallback. The first pins written for it were spies on `has`, and the ablation that plants a member-identical private set at **one** site left the pin **green**.

The repair that works: **withdraw a member** from the shared set and assert that *one site's output* changes, each leg carrying an ordinary `lookup` column as a positive control. Under that shape the ablation reds exactly the intended site — measured one leg per site, each reddening only its own probe.

## Why it is class (b) rather than a style note

The docblock **declares** a property — 「a member-identical private copy fails」 — that the recommended instrument does not deliver under a condition the docblock never names. It is also actively load-bearing: the text reads as guidance, and the next consumer to be pinned will copy the spy.

⚠️ **Not claimed**: that the two existing consumers' pins are vacuous today. That depends on whether either has two call sites on one render, and ⛔ it was not measured. ⇒ the deliverable is (i) name the condition in the docblock and (ii) check the two existing pins against it — ⛔ not a blanket rewrite.

## Provenance and radius

Measured by the dev on objectui#10112, against its own pins, and disclosed rather than quietly fixed. Radius: the `EXPANDABLE_FIELD_TYPES` pin pattern and the one consumer measured. ⛔ Outside: the two pre-existing consumers, and any other set in the repo pinned by spying on a membership method — the same weakness would apply wherever that shape is copied.

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat #1 (`session_01Xr7APep6jm1Zta3KUzPzZf`). ⛔ Filed bare.

## Dedupe words

`identity pin spy on has vacuous` · `EXPANDABLE_FIELD_TYPES pin two call sites` · `member-identical private copy passes pin` · `withdraw a member instead of spying` · `expand-fields docblock pin guidance`
